bodies.name: Congreso de los Diputados (Spanish Congress of Deputies)
bodies.layout: The header carries the Congreso de los Diputados wordmark logo plus a language selector (Castellano/Català/Euskara/Galego) and a prominent search box icon. Below it sits a mega-menu top nav with five sections — 'Actividad Parlamentaria', 'Organización de la Cámara', 'La Institución', 'Información y Publicaciones', 'Sala de Prensa' — each expanding into multi-column dropdown lists of sub-links. The homepage hero is an image carousel ('Imágenes del Día') cycling institutional photos, followed by a row of icon-tile shortcuts ('Hoy en el Congreso', 'Diputadas y Diputados', 'Iniciativas Parlamentarias', 'Visita virtual') and a Presidenta spotlight card. Lower sections use a dense grid of card modules: 'Destacados', 'Notas de prensa' (press releases list), and footer utility links for 'Transparencia', 'Igualdad', 'Datos abiertos', ending in a legalistic footer with the physical address (Plaza de las Cortes, núm. 1 - 28014 MADRID).
ui_patterns: Cookie consent banner citing specific legal article (Ley 34/2002, art. 22.2) with granular accept options ('Aceptar seleccionadas' / 'Aceptar todas' / 'Más información')
Mega-menu dropdown menu with 4-5 nested columns per top-level item
Multilingual co-official language selector (Castellano, Català, Euskara, Galego) in header
Homepage image carousel driving to an institutional blog ('Fuera de Agenda')
Named official portrait card for the sitting Presidenta linking to a bio page
Numbered/dated press release list format ('Notas de prensa') with full-sentence institutional headlines
Persistent footer utility bar: Contacto, Sugerencias, Accesibilidad, Mapa Web, Preguntas Frecuentes, Aviso legal, Protección de datos, Política de Cookies
Open data / transparency portal shortcuts surfaced as dedicated homepage tiles ('Transparencia', 'Datos abiertos', 'Igualdad')

bodies.name: La Moncloa - Gobierno de España (Spanish Government / Prime Minister's Office)
bodies.layout: The theme is internally named 'RYellow' (visible in asset paths like /Theme/RYellow/img/logo-header.svg), pairing a red/gold institutional skin with the state coat of arms motif. Header includes a sticky logo, a co-official language switcher (Castellano/Català/Galego/Euskara/Valencià/English), a search icon, and a dark-mode toggle. Primary nav has six top items — Presidente, Gobierno, Consejo de Ministros, Prensa, España, Info DANA — each opening a flyout with sub-items and one-line descriptions. The hero is a large single-story lead card followed by a horizontal 'Actividad del presidente' rail of photo-cards, a 'Consejo de Ministros' summary block, and a live 'Hoy en la agenda del Gobierno' timetable listing ministers' appointments by hour. Below that are dense card grids: 'Te puede interesar', 'Noticias de los ministerios' (one card per ministry), 'Destacados' banner tiles, and 'Sitios de interés' linking out to BOE, Punto de acceso general, and Portal de la Transparencia.
ui_patterns: Named theme folder in asset URLs signaling an institutional color scheme (Theme/RYellow)
Dark-mode toggle icon in the persistent header
Live hourly 'Agenda' ticker listing named ministers, their exact title, and verb-first activity descriptions
Per-ministry news module pattern — one photo, one headline, one 'Ver más' link, repeated for every ministerial department
Outbound tiles to sibling official domains (boe.es, transparencia.gob.es, administracion.gob.es) styled as homepage banners
Newsletter subscription block with its own banner illustration
Cookie banner offering only binary Aceptar/Rechazar (Accept/Reject), simpler than Congreso's granular version
Escudo de España (state coat of arms) reused as a generic placeholder image across unrelated news banners

bodies.name: Policía Nacional - Dirección General de la Policía (National Police - Directorate-General of Police)
bodies.layout: Header stacks the Policía Nacional badge/shield logo above the full institutional lockup 'Gobierno de España. Ministerio del Interior. Policía Nacional', signaling the strict ministry-hierarchy branding common to security bodies. Utility icons for 'Dependencias' (station locator), 'Buscar' (search), and 'Contacta' sit top-right, plus external quick links to 'DNI electrónico' and 'Cita previa DNI y pasaporte'. Primary nav is a flat single-row bar: Denuncias, Colabora, Comunicación, Tu Policía, Extranjería, Fondos Europeos, Sede electrónica. The homepage hero is a 'Destacados' image-card carousel followed by an 'Es Noticia' dated headline list and a topical shortcut rail ('Consejos al ciudadano', 'Familia y mujer', 'Trata de seres humanos', 'Más buscados', 'Personas desaparecidas', 'Portal del aspirante'). Footer is organized into four labeled columns (Tus trámites, Colabora, Comunicación, Tu policía) plus legal links and social icons.
ui_patterns: Dual-logo header pattern: police badge graphic stacked above the full Gobierno de España/Ministerio del Interior institutional lockup
Simple technical-cookies-only banner ('únicamente utiliza cookies propias con finalidad técnica')
Emergency/public-safety alert strip above the fold styled like a persistent announcement bar
Direct outbound links to sibling e-government micro-sites (dnielectronico.es, citapreviadnie.es, sede.policia.gob.es) styled as first-class nav items rather than footer links
Dated press-release list format (DD/MM/YY) under 'Es Noticia' using terse crime-bulletin headlines
Topic shortcut menu specifically for vulnerable-population services (Familia y mujer, Trata de seres humanos, Personas desaparecidas)
Four-column categorized footer sitemap (Tus trámites / Colabora / Comunicación / Tu policía) mirroring top-nav taxonomy
Accessibility shortcut link ('Ver accesibilidad') placed immediately after the skip-to-content link, ahead of any branding
